name: slope-chart
title: Slope Chart
description: Before and after on two axes: lines draw in, rises in blue, and new data slides every end to its new place.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas of lines and dots, driven by four shared values per series; labels are plain text placed by springs. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Lines appear drawn and move straight to new values.
a11y.screenReader: One image whose name reads the title, both column headings and every series from start to end value.
a11y.touchTarget: Labels take taps with 13 pt of slop above and below, so 44 pt rows.
